title: Eagle Exploring Game based on real maps
author: Fit-Connection-690
selftext:
Hey guys what do you think? Basically it is a game where you play as an eagle and you explore, everything is reconstructed based on real maps

Do you like the idea?

comments.author: Ohitsworkingnow
comments.body: I like it. Can you not snatch a fish yet? Would’ve been a nice demonstration. I think the river needs some attention as far as visuals go

comments.author: suprachromat
comments.body: This looks super cool, would love to play this in so many areas of the world!

comments.author: Vynallan
comments.body: Wow how’d you get the map so … cool?

comments.author: Gilbert_Reddit
comments.body: Eagle, explore. Is that where the *story* begins or ends?
